integrity: The eight degree-two initial forms were reconstructed by exact integer sparse-polynomial arithmetic and the regular-sequence implication is proved in RESULT.md. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statement is local at the diagonal tensor and concerns exactly the scheme generated by the eight coordinate sub-hyperdeterminants in format \(2\times2\times2\times2\); it does not identify the reduced local structure or classify the global zero set.
title: A multiplicity-\(256\) local model for the eight sub-hyperdeterminants at the diagonal rank-two tensor
